results.detail: Fresh profile shows the local-review guide; keyboard skip link moves to main content.
Skip persists across reload; the footer action reopens onboarding.
The clearly labeled synthetic text was sent only to the local upload API and produced a real configured-playbook review; no output was fabricated.
Uploaded a real text contract, ran the local configured playbook, and inspected actual findings.
A delayed real local document response arrived after a newer selection; the newer selected document remained visible.
At 390 px, findings remain visible and document width does not overflow the viewport.
A failed refresh shows an inline alert; retrying after connectivity returns clears the error.
Loaded the second document and review-summary pages from real local API records. Summaries contain metadata and revision flags but omit issue, check, playbook-snapshot, and AI-detail payloads.
The returning-user guide replays with review-specific guidance and can be dismissed again.
Existing saved review opens without forcing the first-run guide.
Browser requests and audited backend sockets stayed on localhost; AI was not configured or invoked.
